chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Yūnus ibn Ribāṭ, who said:

I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) saying: “Indeed, the people of the truth have never ceased, since they came to be, to remain in hardship. Verily, that is only for a short period, and [after it is] a long well-being.”

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْحَقِّ: the people who adhere to truth and right guidance

ai.seo_question: Why do the people of truth face hardship according to Imam al-Sadiq (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the people of truth are characteristically tried with hardship in this world. It also offers reassurance that such difficulty is limited in duration, while lasting well-being lies ahead.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Yunus Bin Ribat who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The people of the truth have not ceased to be in difficulties since they came into being. But, that is to a short time but for a lengthy well-being’.
en.sarwar: 16. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Yunus ibn Ribat who has said the following: “
I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘The people of truth had always, since their coming into being, been in suffering but that is for a short time which is followed by everlasting happiness.’”
